army_rules.name: Gate of Infinity
army_rules.rules_text:
If your Army Faction is GREY KNIGHTS, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, you can select a number of units from your army that are on the battlefield (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), provided every model in those units has this ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:

Incursion: Up to 2 units.
Strike Force: Up to 3 units.
Onslaught: Up to 4 units.

Place those units in Strategic Reserves. Those units can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase, including in your first turn.

Errata: The last paragraph is changed to: Place those units in Strategic Reserves. Those units can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase, including in your first turn.

options.name: Incursion
options.rules_text: Up to 2 eligible GREY KNIGHTS units can be selected.

options.name: Strike Force
options.rules_text: Up to 3 eligible GREY KNIGHTS units can be selected.

options.name: Onslaught
options.rules_text: Up to 4 eligible GREY KNIGHTS units can be selected.

rule.name: Duty Before All
rule.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Eye of the Augurium
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do: That use is -1CP. That use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Inescapable Judgement (Psychic)
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.name: Sanctic Reaper
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR model only. Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Nemesis Rounds
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

stratagems.name: Giants of the Battlefield
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Unending Fidelity
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Point-blank Purgation
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.

stratagems.name: Grind Them Underfoot
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: Precognitive Strategies
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Shining Resolve
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rule.name: Fury of Titan
rule.rules_text: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Banishing Wave (Psychic)
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer: on a 2-5, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Blinding Aura
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Purity of Purpose
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Tome of Forbidden Ways
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Gate of Infinity rule.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Channeling
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Combat Manifestation
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Purgation Pattern
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Duty Unending
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GREY KNIGHTS units from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Shining Veil
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Expeditious Exit
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.notes: This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

rule.name: Channelled Force
rule.rules_text: Each time a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army is selected to fight, that unit can take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, select one of the following rules. Until the end of the phase, that unit has that rule: Melee weapons equipped by models in that unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability; or melee weapons equipped by models in that unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

options.name: Channelled Force - Sustained Hits
options.rules_text: If the Leadership test is passed, melee weapons equipped by models in this Grey Knights unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

options.name: Channelled Force - Lethal Hits
options.rules_text: If the Leadership test is passed, melee weapons equipped by models in this Grey Knights unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

enhancements.name: Sigil of the Hunt
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: The Ephemeral Tome
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer's unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", and until the end of the turn, the bearer's unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: The Sixty-sixth Seal
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Pyresoul (Psychic)
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the bearer; that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Hexwrought Reprisal
stratagems.timing: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

stratagems.name: Warding Chant
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.

stratagems.name: Chaos Bane
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.

stratagems.name: Celerity
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Circle of Sanctuary
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.

stratagems.name: Shadow of Anarch
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Mailed Fist
rule.rules_text: Each time a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.name: Driven by Duty
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS WALKER model only. Each time the bearer's unit Piles In or Consolidates, the bearer can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

enhancements.name: Quickening Foci
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. In your Movement phase, each time the bearer's unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Sigil of Exigence
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, in your opponent's Shooting phase, when the bearer's unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack, you can remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and then set it back up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units. If the bearer's unit is no longer an eligible target, your opponent can then select new targets for any attacks that had targeted the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Spiritus Machina
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, if the bearer's unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Will
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Abominus-class Targets
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Armoured Aegis
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

stratagems.name: Redoubled Assault
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Force Wave
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Argent Wrath
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

rule.name: Prescient Redeployment
rule.rules_text: From the second battle round onwards, at the start of your Movement phase, if you did not select the maximum number of GREY KNIGHTS units from your army using the Gate of Infinity ability at the end of your opponent's previous turn, you can select one GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is on the battlefield that could have been selected using the Gate of Infinity ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
rule.notes: Your unit can retain its position on the battlefield at the end of your Command phase, and then be placed into Strategic Reserves at the start of your Movement phase, to set it up again in your Reinforcements step in another position.

enhancements.name: Grimoire Of Conjunctions
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 4 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Shield Of Prophecy
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the battle round, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: One Foot In The Future
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. When this unit ends an ingress move, you can use this ability. If you do: This unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". Until the end of the turn, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Doomseer's Amulet
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up in your Reinforcements step, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Anticipation
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks can re-roll Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Appointed Hour
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Forewarned Evasion
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS WALKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Necessary End
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Redirected Strike
stratagems.timing: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.notes: This Stratagem lets players utilize abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.

stratagems.name: Mirage Of Echoes
stratagems.timing: The Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Hallowed Ground
rule.rules_text:
Purging corrupted nodes of Warp energy, the Grey Knights establish an ever-expanding area of hallowed ground within which their psychic powers and indomitable resolve are greatly enhanced.

Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army's Hallowed Ground, as follows:
- Your deployment zone is always within your army's Hallowed Ground.
- The area of the battlefield within 6" of one or more PURIFIER SQUAD units from your army is within your army's Hallowed Ground.
- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man's Land, until the end of that phase, No Man's Land is within your army's Hallowed Ground.
- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent's deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent's deployment zone is within your army's Hallowed Ground.

Each time a model in a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible target or makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD and/or is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

options.name: Hallowed Ground
options.rules_text: This unit is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground; re-roll Hit rolls instead of only Hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Mandulian Reliquary
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer's unit is not Battle-shocked, add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Radiant Champion
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability, and while the bearer is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground, each time a melee attack made by the bearer scores a wound, the target of that attack suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage.

enhancements.name: Phial Of The Abyss
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Paragon Of Sanctity
enhancements.rules_text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can select one friendly GREY KNIGHTS unit within 18" of and visible to it. If it does, until the end of the phase, that unit is within your army's Hallowed Ground.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Kill Zone
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.

stratagems.name: Flames Of Sanctity
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One PURIFIER SQUAD unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes CASTELLAN CROWE; on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Hallowed Beacon
stratagems.timing: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding TERMINATOR units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Fires Of Covenant
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground; on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Aegis Eternal
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Repelling Sphere
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground.

rule.name: Dauntless Champions
rule.rules_text:
To be a Paladin of the Grey Knights is to do battle with the greatest and most terrible enemies and yet emerge victorious, no matter the odds.

When a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight, if the S of those attacks is lower than the T of the target, those attacks have +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Psychic Celerity
enhancements.rules_text: TERMINATOR model only. This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Vigilance of Titan
enhancements.rules_text: TERMINATOR model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit has -6" detection range.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Aegis
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: A Threat Ended
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Aura of Vengeance
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit's melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].

rule.name: Searing Soulflame
rule.rules_text:
Through potent psychic focus and the channelling of their vehement wrath, Purgators imbue their salvos with bursts of soul-burning psy-fire.

When you select a unit to be pinned by a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit's Righteous Persecution ability, that enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

enhancements.name: Precognicient Volleys
enhancements.rules_text: PURGATION SQUAD unit only. This unit's snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

enhancements.name: Boons of Deimos
enhancements.rules_text: PURGATION SQUAD unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have +2 S.

stratagems.name: Soul-locked
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Focused Immolation
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.

rule.name: Echojump
rule.rules_text:
Pushing their esoteric wargear to its limits, Interceptors are able to make secondary, shorter personal teleportation jumps effectively skimming the very surface of the Immaterium to respond all the more quickly to developing threats.

In your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do:
- That unit cannot use its Personal Teleporters ability.
- That unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a Fall Back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is unengaged.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
